svg.text: THE INTENT LEASE CONTRACT: SPATIAL TOLERANCE & TEMPORAL EXPIRATION
Bounding Cognitive Intent in Space, Time, and Wrench to Guarantee Safe Termination upon Silence or Failure

g.text: Actuators drive unmonitored mass through shifted space
SYSTEMS INVARIANT: A goal must die on its own.
Silence is safe. Autonomous expiration eliminates reliance on a failed supervisor.
